prompt: What marketing decision do you need to stay ahead of?
description: Build a cited, continuously updated picture of competitors, products, customers, markets, narratives, and marketing performance.
starter_prompts: Keep me ahead of competitor, customer, product, and market shifts that could change our strategy.
Show where competitor claims are moving faster than their evidence or execution.
Find market and customer changes that should alter our positioning, launches, or investment.

outcomes.label: Understand competitors and positioning
outcomes.description: Track offers, pricing, claims, launches, investments, partnerships, and execution evidence.

outcomes.label: Guide product and portfolio decisions
outcomes.description: Connect product capabilities, pricing, adoption, performance, and unmet needs across the lifecycle.

outcomes.label: Understand markets and emerging demand
outcomes.description: Follow category growth, segments, investment, regulation, technology, and demand catalysts.

outcomes.label: Understand customers and buying behavior
outcomes.description: Combine customer voice, behavior, needs, objections, satisfaction, and buying-stage evidence.

outcomes.label: Improve marketing performance
outcomes.description: Orient teams around campaign, content, channel, conversion, spend, and revenue evidence.

outcomes.label: Detect narrative and messaging shifts
outcomes.description: See how category language, executive narratives, competitive claims, and customer expectations are changing.

source_groups.label: Competitor public evidence
source_groups.description: Websites, product pages, pricing, documentation, launches, job postings, and public statements.

source_groups.label: Market and company records
source_groups.description: Filings, earnings materials, patents, government records, research, and category publications.

source_groups.label: News, social, and narratives
source_groups.description: Independent reporting, executive commentary, events, communities, and category conversation.

source_groups.label: Customer voice
source_groups.description: Reviews plus optional surveys, interviews, support conversations, community posts, and win/loss evidence.

source_groups.label: Owned marketing and revenue data
source_groups.description: CRM, web analytics, campaign performance, content engagement, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.

cadences.label: Urgent only
cadences.description: Only material competitive, customer, market, or performance thresholds.

cadences.label: Daily pulse
cadences.description: A concise orientation plus urgent shifts and contradictions.

cadences.label: Weekly briefing
cadences.description: The week's movement, implications, opportunities, and next catalysts.
